samples.xml_description:
<module id="alu">
    <description>ALU for MIPS ISA CPU</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="a" width_description="[31:0]">First operand.</input>
        <input id="b" width_description="[31:0]">Second operand.</input>
        <input id="aluc" width_description="[5:0]">Control signal for operation selection.</input>
        <output id="r" width_description="[31:0]">Result of the operation.</output>
        <output id="zero">Zero flag indicating if the result is zero.</output>
        <output id="carry">Carry flag indicating if a carry occurred during the operation.</output>
        <output id="negative">Negative flag indicating if the result is negative.</output>
        <output id="overflow">Overflow flag indicating if an overflow occurred during the operation.</output>
        <output id="flag">General flag, set based on specific operations (SLT and SLTU).</output>
    </ports>
    
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="ADD" value="6'b100000"></parameter>
        <parameter id="ADDU" value="6'b100001"></parameter>
        <parameter id="SUB" value="6'b100010"></parameter>
        <parameter id="SUBU" value="6'b100011"></parameter>
        <parameter id="AND" value="6'b100100"></parameter>
        <parameter id="OR" value="6'b100101"></parameter>
        <parameter id="XOR" value="6'b100110"></parameter>
        <parameter id="NOR" value="6'b100111"></parameter>
        <parameter id="SLT" value="6'b101010"></parameter>
        <parameter id="SLTU" value="6'b101011"></parameter>
        <parameter id="SLL" value="6'b000000"></parameter>
        <parameter id="SRL" value="6'b000010"></parameter>
        <parameter id="SRA" value="6'b000011"></parameter>
        <parameter id="SLLV" value="6'b000100"></parameter>
        <parameter id="SRLV" value="6'b000110"></parameter>
        <parameter id="SRAV" value="6'b000111"></parameter>
        <parameter id="LUI" value="6'b001111"></parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <reg id="res" width="32">Register to store the result.</reg>
        <assign id="signed_a" value="($signed(a))"/>
        <assign id="signed_b" value="($signed(b))"/>
        <always_comb>
            case(aluc)
                ADD: res <= $signed(signed_a + signed_b);
                ADDU: res <= a + b;
                SUB: res <= $signed(signed_a - signed_b);
                SUBU: res <= a - b;
                AND: res <= a & b;
                OR: res <= a | b;
                XOR: res <= a ^ b;
                NOR: res <= ~(a | b);
                SLT: res <= ($signed(signed_a) < $signed(signed_b)) ? 1 : 0;
                SLTU: res <= (a < b) ? 1 : 0;
                SLL: res <= b << a[4:0];
                SRL: res <= b >> a[4:0];
                SRA: res <= signed_b >>> signed_a[4:0];
                SLLV: res <= b << a[4:0];
                SRLV: res <= b >> a[4:0];
                SRAV: res <= signed_b >>> signed_a[4:0];
                LUI: res <= {a[15:0], 16'h0};
                default: res <= 32'hzzzzzzzz;
            endcase
        </always_comb>
        
        <assign id="r" value="res[31:0]"/>
        <assign id="flag" value="(aluc == SLT || aluc == SLTU) ? 1 : 1'bz"/>
        <assign id="zero" value=(res==32'd0)?1:0/>
        <assign id="carry" value="1'bz"/>
        <assign id="negative" value=res[31]/1'/>
        <assign id="overflow" value="1'bz"/>
    </logic_description>
</module>
